glosses: grounding (state of being confined by one’s parents, as punishment)

examples.text: Tom ficou três semanas de castigo.
examples.en: Tom has been grounded for three weeks.

examples.text: Achei que você estivesse de castigo.
Não vamos conseguir fugir do castigo desta vez.
examples.en: We won't be able to evade punishment this time.

examples.text: Ela enfrentou o castigo com um sorriso.
examples.en: She took the punishment with a smile.
